evidence.key_mechanism_note: PARTIAL-ROT ends with FEWER TQQQ shares than buy-and-hold (405 vs 487 in the backtest) because it redeploys on recoveries and buys higher. Buying MORE shares requires redeploying LOWER than the trim price; no tested redeploy rule does that consistently.
evidence.source: Backtest 6 (Oct 27, 2026), ~/workspace/tqqq-agentic-backtest/SUMMARY6_jun_trim_dip.md — TQQQ + bills, daily, trim-once semantics, cash 0%, no commissions/slippage (flatters timers). Backtests 3-5 covered binary rotation and rebalancing variants for contrast.

evidence.verdict: PARTIAL-ROT 30% is the current champion on the criterion that matters most — worst-window survival (81.9%, best of any timer tested) — and it beats buy-and-hold in crash windows (110.2% in 2018-26, 163.8% from the Nov 2021 top). It TRAILS buy-and-hold over the full period (85.9%) and in bull years (81.9%), because keeping 70% invested through a bull still lags holding 100%. No tested system beats buy-and-hold by large margins over the full period. The large-margin edge is an open research problem, not a solved claim — see open_research.

falsifiers: A tested variant beats PARTIAL-ROT 30% on the worst window AND on the full period, with the same trim-once semantics and no lookahead — it replaces this system.
A regime change that breaks the monthly-trend premise (e.g. the 10-month MA stops separating bull from bear in the QQQ record) — the system is re-audited, not silently kept.
The October grade inputs are revised by Yahoo (corporate action or restatement) by more than 0.5% — the grade is recomputed and re-verified, not carried forward.

how_to_read: system.rule is the only investment rule. Do not invent a second rule from the control group or the related systems.

evidence.verdict is the honest score: the system trails buy-and-hold over a full bull run and beats it in crash windows. Never present it as beating buy-and-hold by large margins over the full period — no tested variant does.
live is recomputed daily from data/market-candles/QQQ.json and TQQQ.json. monthly_grade changes only at a month-end close. live.current changes every trading day.
related_systems are separate systems. Do not merge the Agentic watcher, the survival grid, or the inflow study into system.rule.
how_to_update: Daily: refresh live.current from the latest candle closes; recompute distances to the exit line and to the TQQQ Labs line; update updatedAt. Do not touch system, evidence, or monthly_grade on a daily run.

At a month-end close: recompute monthly_grade from the 10 monthly closes preceding the completed month (see system.rule.ma_window). If the recomputed 10-month MA differs from a stored verified MA by more than 0.5%, keep the stored value, set live.verification.drift=true, and flag it for Jun — never silently overwrite a verified grade.
Never change system.rule parameters, evidence numbers, or the verdict without Jun's explicit approval and a new backtest result recorded in evidence.sources.
for_ai.purpose: This file is the single machine-readable blueprint for how TQQQ must be invested in this operation. Any AI reading it should be able to state the rule, grade the current month, and update the live block without changing the system.

live.next_grade: Next month-end close. The MA for that test is the 10 completed months through the just-closed month — recompute then; the stored MA does NOT carry forward.

objective: A systematic TQQQ approach that beats buy-and-hold TQQQ by large margins. Buy-and-hold is the benchmark. The current best system does not yet clear that bar over the full period — see evidence.verdict. This file is the blueprint plus the research program to get there.

system.name: PARTIAL-ROT 30%
system.origin: Jun's own design, Oct 27 2026 (Backtest 6). His claim: pulling 30% to bills in a bear market and holding the rest beats binary rotation. Graded half-right — see evidence.
system.parameter_note: Parameters were set by Jun's design, not tuned. The 0.67%-style fine tuning seen in the TQQQ Labs control group is explicitly rejected here — Jun's own band sweep showed band choice swings results 2x.

rule_formal.execution: Trade at the month-end close when the state changes
rule_formal.ma_window: 10 completed months preceding the month being graded
rule_formal.reentry: Monthly close back above the 10-month moving average
rule_formal.signal: QQQ monthly close vs 10-month moving average of completed monthly closes
rule_formal.universe: TQQQ + Treasury bills (cash yields 0% in backtest)

system.rule_plain: Hold TQQQ. At each month-end, if QQQ's monthly close is 5% or more below its 10-month moving average, hold 70% TQQQ and 30% Treasury bills. Otherwise hold 100% TQQQ. Trade only when the state changes — never rebalance daily.
